title: TriageBloom: Explainable Cross-Event Security Triage for Resource-Constrained SOCs

secondary_dataset.name: LANL Comprehensive Multi-Source Cyber-Security Events
secondary_dataset.role: authentication stress and sanity check only

primary_questions: RQ1: Does sequence-aware correlation improve incident-level prioritisation over isolated or uncorrelated detection for supported attack patterns?
RQ2: How do learner, balanced and strict profiles change the precision-recall and alert-volume trade-off on independently collected security-event data?
RQ3: What computational cost does the deterministic triage pipeline impose on commodity hardware?
real_environment_interpretation: Unlabelled real-environment events are not treated as proven benign. Precision, recall and false-positive rate are therefore not primary real-environment claims.
freeze_rules: Run schema and supported-technique audit before final scoring.
Freeze the TriageBloom commit and profile configurations before the final test run.
Use development samples only for parser/schema debugging.
Do not change thresholds in response to final-test misses.
Report excluded techniques and event classes with reasons.
Keep synthetic regression results separate from external validation.
Report negative results and ATT&CK-label disagreements.
Preserve dataset hashes, command lines, environment details and the exact commit used.
claim_boundaries: TriageBloom does not claim comprehensive ATT&CK coverage.
COMISET ATT&CK annotations are treated as reference labels, not perfect forensic ground truth.
A low-severity off-hours login is not treated as evidence of compromise.
No analyst-productivity claim will be made without a separate human study.
No superiority claim against Sentinel, Defender, Sigma or an ML/LLM system will be made without a fair direct comparison.
